description: Inline column filter control for TmDataTable that renders a text input, number/date input, boolean select, or custom select dropdown depending on FilterType configuration.

parameters.name: ColumnTitle
parameters.description: Column caption. When set, the accessible name and placeholder use TmDataTable_FilterColumn ("Filter: {0}"). Omitted keeps the generic Filter label.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Controlled filter text. When set, it overwrites the inner value on every parameter update. Null leaves the control uncontrolled.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Raised with the new text when the user edits or clears the filter.

parameters.name: FilterOperator
parameters.description: Operator sent with the filter. Null or whitespace keeps the historical contains operator.
